title: Corrupted or mutated evidence archive
narrative: A delivered study.pcs.zip fails canonical archive checks: a member hash mismatches, and one path looks suspicious. The accompanying PDF report still looks polished.
signals: Human-readable report not bound as sole authority

exercises.prompt: Should the polished PDF/report override archive integrity failure?
What artifacts should be preserved for incident analysis?

after_action_criteria: Package rejected or held pending reissue
Human report not treated as authority
No live credential changes performed by the simulator
